note: Styles artistiques du générateur Melodia. « prompt » reste côté serveur. Références décrites de façon générique (époques, techniques), aucun nom d'artiste vivant. Exclus volontairement : pop art, glitch, cyberpunk, dessin animé, manga, néon, vaporwave, graffiti, pixel art, 3D brillante, caricature. « desc » (français, court) est public ; « prompt » ne quitte jamais le serveur.

styles.desc: Lavis transparents, papier visible, très doux.
styles.prompt: delicate watercolor painting on cold-pressed cotton paper, soft wet-on-wet washes, gentle blooms and granulation, translucent layers, ivory paper left visible as light, muted gold and warm grey pigments. Texture: cold-pressed paper tooth, soft pigment edges, no hard outlines. Composition: airy, subject slightly off-centre, generous untouched paper around it.

styles.desc: Peinture classique, glacis riches, lumière chaude.
styles.prompt: classical oil painting on canvas, rich glazes and visible soft brushwork, warm umber underpainting, deep shadows and luminous ivory highlights, subtle gold tones, museum-quality fine art finish. Texture: fine canvas weave, soft impasto only on the highlights. Composition: balanced classical still-life framing, dark warm background, light falling from one side.

styles.desc: Touches fragmentées, lumière vibrante, plein air.
styles.prompt: late nineteenth-century French impressionist painting, broken brushstrokes capturing soft natural light, shimmering atmosphere, gentle pastel ivory and gold light, calm and luminous. Texture: visible dabs of oil paint, soft edges dissolving into light. Composition: natural and open, light from a window or the sky as the true subject.

styles.desc: Plans géométriques apaisés, comme un vitrail moderne.
styles.prompt: gentle cubist composition with softly faceted planes and overlapping translucent geometric shards, harmonious balance, palette of deep blue-black, ivory and warm gold, stained-glass-like light, serene rather than aggressive. Texture: matte painted planes with fine dark contour lines. Composition: stable and centred, few large facets, nothing fragmented or broken.

styles.desc: Rêve calme et poétique, ciel limpide, juxtapositions douces.
styles.prompt: calm poetic surrealism in the manner of early twentieth-century Belgian painters, smooth precise painting, quiet dreamlike juxtapositions, clear soft sky, still and contemplative, no distortion, no horror. Texture: smooth, almost invisible brushwork, clean edges. Composition: clear horizon, one quiet unexpected element, lots of calm sky.

styles.desc: Un seul sujet, beaucoup d'espace, grande sérénité.
styles.prompt: minimalist fine art composition, a single quiet subject, vast negative space, restrained palette of warm black, ivory and a single thin touch of gold, soft even light, clean and serene. Texture: smooth matte surfaces, very subtle paper or plaster grain. Composition: single subject placed low or off-centre, at least two thirds of empty space.

styles.desc: Lignes végétales fluides, ornement 1900, tons sauge et or.
styles.prompt: Art Nouveau decorative illustration from around 1900, flowing organic lines, lilies and arabesques, elegant ornamental border, muted ivory, sage and antique gold, lithographic poster texture. Texture: lithographic flat colour with slight paper grain, fine contour lines. Composition: symmetrical, framed by a soft ornamental arch of lilies and stems.

styles.desc: Symétrie élégante, lignes d'or fines, noir laqué.
styles.prompt: 1920s Art Deco style, elegant symmetry, fine geometric gold lines and sunburst motifs, black lacquer and ivory, refined and solemn, polished but not flashy. Texture: lacquer, polished brass and smooth ivory. Composition: strict vertical symmetry, rays fanning gently behind the subject, refined restraint.

styles.desc: Gravure fine en hachures, encre sépia sur papier crème.
styles.prompt: fine etching and engraving on cream laid paper, delicate cross-hatching and stippling, warm sepia-black ink, plate-tone around the image, nineteenth-century print craftsmanship. Texture: crisp etched lines, cross-hatching, warm plate tone, laid paper. Composition: vignette-like, subject centred with the edges fading into the paper.

styles.desc: Dessin au fusain velouté, noirs profonds, gestes calmes.
styles.prompt: charcoal drawing on textured off-white paper, soft smudged tones and expressive yet calm strokes, deep velvety blacks, gentle highlights lifted with an eraser, intimate study. Texture: grainy paper, smudged charcoal, lifted highlights. Composition: intimate study, subject close, background left as soft smudge.

styles.desc: Verre coloré cerné de plomb, lumière qui traverse.
styles.prompt: stained glass window, luminous coloured glass pieces held by dark lead lines, light shining through in deep blue, amber and gold, ivory panes, sacred calm without religious figures. Texture: translucent glass with slight bubbles and variations, dark lead came lines. Composition: arched window shape, symmetrical, light glowing from behind.

styles.desc: Estampe japonaise ancienne, aplats doux, papier washi.
styles.prompt: traditional Japanese woodblock print (ukiyo-e), flat areas of muted colour, fine black key lines, subtle bokashi gradients, washi paper texture, quiet poetic landscape sensibility. Texture: woodblock flat colour, soft bokashi gradient, washi fibres. Composition: asymmetric, clean empty margins, one quiet focal subject.

styles.desc: Encre noire au pinceau, vide, méditation.
styles.prompt: East Asian ink wash painting (sumi-e), expressive minimal brushstrokes in black ink on rice paper, soft grey gradations, generous empty space, a single tiny touch of warm gold, meditative. Texture: ink on absorbent rice paper, dry-brush edges, soft grey washes. Composition: few strokes, subject on one side, large meditative emptiness.

styles.desc: Une seule lumière chaude qui sort le sujet de l'ombre.
styles.prompt: seventeenth-century baroque chiaroscuro oil painting, a single warm light source carving the subject out of deep darkness, rich browns and golds, dramatic yet tender stillness. Texture: smooth glazed oil paint, deep transparent shadows. Composition: subject lit by a single candle or window, everything else falling into warm darkness.

styles.desc: Craie veloutée sur papier teinté, tout en douceur.
styles.prompt: soft pastel drawing on toned paper, velvety chalky strokes, gentle blended transitions, warm ivory, dusty rose and muted gold, tender and luminous. Texture: velvety chalk strokes, toned paper showing through. Composition: soft, centred, edges dissolving gently into the paper tone.

styles.desc: Manuscrit ancien, feuille d'or, marges fleuries, sans texte.
styles.prompt: medieval illuminated manuscript page style, fine tempera painting on vellum, delicate gold leaf accents, ornamental floral margins, deep ultramarine and ivory, precious and devotional in mood without text. Texture: tempera on vellum, raised burnished gold leaf, fine brush detail. Composition: central miniature framed by a floral border, absolutely no lettering.

styles.desc: Atmosphère mystérieuse et rêveuse, brume dorée.
styles.prompt: late nineteenth-century symbolist painting, dreamy and mystical atmosphere, soft hazy light, muted jewel tones with gold, allegorical calm, poetic and melancholic. Texture: soft blended oil with a hazy glow, slightly dreamlike edges. Composition: centred and still, subject emerging from a soft golden haze.

styles.desc: Détail botanique minutieux, couleurs joyaux, romantique.
styles.prompt: Pre-Raphaelite painting style, meticulous botanical detail, luminous jewel-like colours on a white ground, lilies and roses, rich greens and ivory, romantic medieval mood. Texture: fine, luminous oil glazes over a white ground, every petal crisp. Composition: rich close still life, foliage framing the subject, calm and lush.

styles.desc: Photo sur pellicule, grain doux, couleurs chaudes et vraies.
styles.prompt: analog film photograph, medium-format camera, natural soft light, fine organic grain, gentle warm colour rendition, slight vignetting, honest and intimate. Texture: organic film grain, gentle halation on highlights. Composition: natural framing, shallow depth of field, honest window light.

styles.desc: Photographie noir et blanc, noirs riches, intemporelle.
styles.prompt: fine art black and white photograph, silver gelatin print look, deep rich blacks and luminous whites, subtle grain, soft directional light, timeless and contemplative. Texture: silver gelatin tonality, fine grain, deep blacks with detail. Composition: strong simple shapes, single directional light, quiet negative space. Monochrome only.

styles.desc: Couches de papier découpé, ombres douces, contre-jour doré.
styles.prompt: layered cut-paper art, several layers of ivory, cream and dark paper with soft shadows between them, delicate hand-cut silhouettes, gentle backlight glowing in gold. Texture: real paper layers with soft cast shadows and fibre edges. Composition: depth built in three to five layers, subject in the front layer, light glowing behind.

styles.desc: Petites tesselles de pierre et d'or, dignité antique.
styles.prompt: ancient mosaic made of small stone and glass tesserae, subtle irregular grout lines, gold smalti catching the light, ivory, deep blue and terracotta, Byzantine dignity. Texture: irregular tesserae, grout lines, gold smalti catching light. Composition: frontal and centred, simple readable shapes, plain gold or ivory field behind.

styles.desc: Image faite de petits points de couleur pure, lumineuse.
styles.prompt: neo-impressionist pointillism, the image built from countless small dots of pure colour, soft luminous vibration, harmonious ivory, gold and dusk blue palette, peaceful. Texture: countless distinct small dots, no blended strokes. Composition: calm and balanced, soft light vibrating across the whole surface.

styles.desc: Grand paysage brumeux au crépuscule, paix et grandeur.
styles.prompt: nineteenth-century Romantic landscape painting, vast calm nature, misty distance and glowing sky at dusk, sense of the sublime and of peace, warm gold light on dark land. Texture: smooth oil glazes, luminous sky, soft atmospheric perspective. Composition: low horizon, vast sky, small quiet subject in the landscape.

styles.desc: Tempera et fond d'or bruni, formes plates et solennelles.
styles.prompt: icon painting technique, egg tempera on wooden panel with burnished gold leaf background, flat serene forms, fine craquelure, deep red-brown and ivory, solemn and luminous, no saints or religious figures. Texture: egg tempera on gesso panel, burnished gold leaf, fine craquelure. Composition: frontal, symmetrical, subject centred on a plain gold ground, no figures.

styles.desc: Gravure taillée, traits francs, deux ou trois couleurs.
styles.prompt: linocut print, bold carved lines and textured ink coverage, two or three colours only (black, ivory, ochre gold), visible hand-printed texture on paper, simple and strong. Texture: carved gouge marks, uneven ink coverage, paper texture. Composition: bold simple silhouette, strong contrast, clear negative shapes.

styles.desc: Peinture murale sur chaux, tons mats et patinés.
styles.prompt: Renaissance fresco painted on lime plaster, soft chalky matte colours, gentle ochres, ivory and faded blue, subtle cracks and patina of an old wall, serene and timeless. Texture: lime plaster, chalky matte pigment, fine cracks and patina. Composition: calm horizontal arrangement, soft architectural frame, faded edges.

styles.desc: Tirage bleu de Prusse, silhouettes de fleurs en blanc.
styles.prompt: cyanotype botanical print, deep Prussian blue and white, delicate silhouette shapes of flowers and leaves, handmade paper texture with brush-stroke edges, quiet and archival. Texture: handmade paper, brushed emulsion edges, crisp white silhouettes. Composition: botanical, flat, subject laid across the sheet with breathing space. Blue and white only.
